brand.taglineShort: Change filters on schedule — not on marketing.

methodology: We log static pressure drop (in. w.c.) at the filter slot monthly on three test homes: dusty rural, suburban pets, and urban apartment.
Replacement intervals are validated against manufacturer claims only when particle capture still meets the home's stated goal (allergies = MERV 11+ equivalent).
Subscription reorder cadence is tracked for 90 days before we recommend or warn against any auto-ship program.
We do not accept sponsorship from Filtrete, Honeywell, Lennox, or other OEM filter lines; affiliate revenue only on third-party equivalents we install.
Every interval claim cites climate, pet load, and runtime hours; if we cannot source it, we publish a range instead of a single number.
Reader corrections are answered within 72 hours and folded into the calendar or rebutted with dated test notes.

about.headline: Why FilterCycle exists
about.body: We built FilterCycle after a stack of "replace every 30 days" emails that did not match how dusty the house actually was — or what the pressure gauge on the furnace said. We publish interval math, part-number crosswalks, and subscription comparisons so you spend less on filters and breathe better air.
